note: Head-term lexicon for demand families (scripts/search_intelligence/demand_families.js). Checked in order, first match wins, against the normalised query (and, for a guide, its route + title to give the page its intent). A query that matches nothing inherits the intent of the page Google showed for it: a state hub serves choose_provider, a guide with no match serves its own topic. Families are (intent, landing page); state hubs collapse to /states/{STATE}/ because one template renders them all. choose_provider is last because 'lawyer', 'dentist' and 'clinic' also appear inside the narrower intents. provider_business is first: practice valuations, contact lists, leads and listings are searches by providers, not by the patients and clients these sites serve.
